about: Inspect the implementation diff, write focused and boundary tests for paginate(), fix the off-by-one bug revealed, and emit structured test_findings and added_tests.

request.prompt: Fix paginate() in src/paginate.js so trailing partial pages work accurately, reject non-integer bounds cleanly, and cover boundary behavior. R-1: Return all items for trailing partial pages (Math.ceil total pages) and reject non-positive or non-integer page/size arguments with RangeError.

work_item.title: Fix pagination page-count and boundary handling
work_item.context: Fix trailing partial page truncation in src/paginate.js and add focused tests including partial-page and out-of-range cases.

step-plan.summary: Plan 2 steps: S1 fixes paginate page calculation (C1); S2 adds server pagination endpoint (C2).

criteria.text: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 2, 2) returns page 2 of 3 pages with [3,4] and partial page 3 with [5]. Confirm by: running node --test --test-name-pattern 'TC-1' test/paginate.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.
GET /items?page=2 exposes paginated results in server.js. Confirm by: running node --test test/server.test.js; pass when exit 0. Serves R-1.

steps.task: Update paginate() in src/paginate.js to compute pages with Math.ceil (C1).

step-plan.check_na: Dependency-free Node fixture has no separate lint or build step.

test-spec.summary: Specify TC-1 for S1 partial page and TC-2 for S2 server route.

test_cases.oracle: paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 3, 2) returns {page: 3, pages: 3, items: [5]} and paginate([1], 2, 1) returns items: [].
test_cases.red: paginate uses Math.floor on base so pages is 2 and page 3 returns [] instead of [5].
test_cases.green: paginate uses Math.ceil so pages is 3 and page 3 returns [5].

not_covered.behaviour: Empty input array paginate([], 1, 5) returns pages: 0, items: [] without throwing.
not_covered.reason: Covered in test stage as a boundary sub-case TC-1 (a).

learned: Math.ceil fixes partial trailing page counts cleanly.
decisions: Keep 1-based page indexing and RangeError checks.

planted.what: Result writes TC-1 plus boundary sub-case TC-1 (a) into test/paginate.test.js and registers added_tests.
Result records structured test_findings naming remaining server validation gap.

controls.what: node --test passes with both TC-1 and TC-1 (a).
